e82d84cd510e127ea76cb153a175d44ad12d761f.summary: Doron Karmi's write-up of three Konni malware campaigns observed in 2019 (January to late September). Macro-armed lure Word documents run certutil to fetch later stages, which bypass UAC, persist through the COMSysApp service, and exfiltrate data over a free FTP service. Konni is potentially linked to APT37, a North Korean espionage group. A possible overlap with the Syscon backdoor was noted but not confirmed.
